yaTAgamam । devI maNgalacaRqI yA tadAKyAnaM niSAmaya ॥ tasyAH pUjAdikaM sarvvaM DarmmavaktveRa yacCrutam । SrutisammatamevezwaM sarvvezAM viduzAmapi ॥ dakzAyAM varttate caRqI kalyARezu ca maNgalam । maNgalezu ca yA dakzA sA ca maNgalacaRqikA ॥ pUjyAyAM varttate caRqI maNgale'pi mahIsutaH । maNgalABIzwadevI yA sA vA maNgalacaRqikA ॥ maNgalo manuvaMSaSca saptadvIpaDarApatiH । tasya pUjyABIzwadezI tena maNgalacaRqikA ॥ mUrttiBedena sA durgA mUlaprakftirISvarI । kfpArUpAtipratyakzA yozitAmizwadevatA ॥ praTame pUjitA sA ca SaNkareRa puraH purA । tripurasya vaDe Gore vizRunA preritena ca ॥ brahman ! brahmopadeSena durgaprasTena saNkawe । AkASAt patite yAne dEtyena pAtite ruzA ॥ brahmavizRUpadizwaSca durgAM tuzwAva SaNkaraH । sA ca maNgalacaRqI ca baBUva rUpaBedataH ॥ uvAca purataH SamBorBayaM nAstIti te viBo ! । BagavAn vfzarUpaSca sarvveSaSca baBUva ha ॥ yudDaSaktisvarUpAhaM BavizyAmi tadAjYayA । mayAmunA ca hariRA sahAyena vfzaDvaja ! ॥ jahi dEtyaYca SatruYca surARAM padaGAtakam । ityuktvAntarhitA devI SamBoH SaktirbaBUva sA ॥ vizRudattena SastreRa jaGAna tamumApatiH । munIndra ! patite dEtye sarvve devA maharzayaH ॥ tuzwuvuH SaNkaraM devaM BaktinamrAtmakanDarAH । sadyaH Sirasi SamBoSca puzpavfzwirbaBUva ca । brahmA vizRuSca santuzwo dadO tasmE SuBASizam ॥ brahmavizRUpadizwaSca susrAtaH SaNkaraH SuciH । pUjayAmAsa tAM SaktiM devIM maNgalacaRqikAm ॥ pAdyArGyAcamanIyESca baliBirviviDErapi । puzpacandananEvedyErBaktyA nAnAviDErmune ! ॥ CAgErmezESca mahizErgaRqEmAyAtiBistaTA । vastrAlaNkAramAlyESca pAyasEH pizwakErapi ॥ maDuBiSca suDABiSca pakvErnAnAviDEH PalEH । saMgItErnarttanErvAdyErutsavEH kfzRakIrttanEH ॥ DyAtvA mADyandinoktena DyAnena BaktipUrvvakam । dadO dravyARi mUlena mantreREva ca nArada ! ॥ o~ hrIM SrIM klIM sarvvapUjye devi maNgalacaRqike । huM huM Paw svAhetyevaYcApyEkaviMSAkzaro manuH ॥ pUjyaH kalpataruScEva BaktAnAM sarvvakAmadaH । daSalakzajapenEva mantrasidDirBavennfRAm । mantrasidDirBavedyasya sa vizRuH sarvvakAmadaH ॥ DyAnaYca SrUyatAM brahman ! vedoktaM sarvvasammatam ॥ devIM zoqaSavarzIyAM SaSvatsusTirayOvanAm । sarvvarUpaguRAQyAYca komalANgIM manoharAm ॥ SvetacampakavarRABAM candrakowisamapraBAm । vahniSudDAMSukADAnAM ratnaBUzaRaBUzitAm ॥ biBratIM kavarIBAraM mallikAmAlyaBUzitam । vimbozWIM sudatIM SudDAM SaSvatpadmaniBAnanAm ॥ IzadDAsyaprasannAsyAM sunIlotpalalocanAm । jagadDAtrIYca dAtrIYca sarvveByaH sarvvasampadAm । saMsArasAgare Gore potarUpAM varAM Baje ॥ devyASca DyAnamityevaM stavanaM SrUyatAM mune ! । prayAtaH saNkawagrasto yena tuzwAva SaNkaraH ॥ SrISaNkara uvAca । rakza rakza jaganmAtardevi maNgalacaRqike ! । hArike vipadAM rASiM harzamaNgaladAyike ! ॥ harzamaNgaladakze ca harzamaNgalacaRqike ! । SuBe maNgaladakze ca SuBe maNgalacaRqike ! ॥ maNgale maNgalArTe ca sarvvamaNgalamaNgale ! । satAM maNgalade devi ! sarvvezAM maNgalAlaye ! ॥ pUjye ! maNgalavAre ca maNgalABIzwadevate ! । pUjye maNgalaBUpasya manuvaMSasya santatam ॥ maNgalADizWAtfdevi ! maNgalAnAYca maNgale ! । saMsAramaNgalADAre mokzamaNgaladAyini ! ॥ sAre ca maNgalADAre pAre ca sarvvakarmmaRAm । pratimaNgalavAre ca pUjye ca maNgalaprade ! ॥ stotreRAnena SamBuSca stutvA maNgalacaRqikAm । pratimaNgalavAre ca pUjAM kftvA gataH SivaH ॥ devyASca maNgalaM stotraM yaH SfRoti samAhitaH । tanmaNgalaM Bavet SaSvanna BavettadamaNgalam ॥ praTame pUjitA devI Sivena sarvvamaNgalA । dvitIye pUjitA devI maNgalena graheRa ca ॥ tftIye pUjitA BadrA maNgalena nfpeRa ca । caturTe maNgale vAre sundarIBiSca pUjitA ॥ maNgale maNgalAkANkzErnarErmaNgalacaRqikA । pUjitA prativiSvezu viSveSapUjitA sadA ॥ tataH sarvvatra saMpUjyA sA baBUva sureSvarI । devAdiBiSca muniBirmanuBirmAnavErmune !
